items.text: Inside Tom Cruise's Epic Romantic History
items.article: Tom Cruise's greatest love of all is making movies, but he's racked up quite a few romantic credits during his 40 years of stardom, including marriages to Mimi Rogers, Nicole Kidman and Katie Holmes. No one does privacy in the public eye quite like Tom Cruise . The ageless movie star—though he's 64, to get technical—has been up to his usual full-court press promoting Digger , his first movie to not fall squarely within the action genre in almost 15 years, and he's been waxing rhapsodic about his longtime love. "For me, home is on a movie set," Cruise told GQ for its September cover story. "People go, 'Where do you live?' I’m like, 'On movie sets. And around the world. I’m a citizen of the world, a citizen of humanity.'" Since home is where the heart is, it stands to reason that the thrice-married actor's heart belongs to the movies. And he certainly doesn't mind questions about that . As he was touring the globe in support of the May 2025 release of Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning , the eighth and seemingly last film in the $4 billion-dollar franchise that he led since 1996 , he made sure to not confirm that he and Ana de Armas were an item following some cozy-looking sightings of him with the Ballerina actress. He went as far as to praise her as "very, very talented," describing de Armas to Extra as a "very dramatic actor, comedic," with "tremendous ability. Learns quickly."
